==Behind the scenes==
Hazard Toss first appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity as part of the [[2026]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] Nightlife annual event in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''.<ref name="News">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20260625|text=Nar Shaddaa Nightlife returns on June 30 with new rewards!}}</ref>
